title: Orsen and the Confession
author: Wendell Yarrow
blurb: Dominic Vasquez, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
